column6: A waiting baseline draft is an inbox card, approved under the session's one device code
Approve to build is an inbox card, with its stories, budget, agents, milestones, and high-risk entries
Bugs come last: a mission ends with a BUGS milestone, and a Bug filed during the mission joins it
The morning is set: the inbox orders the day's cards and ends with the day's plan
The evening review: each story agreed this morning, with each criterion next to its evidence
The day is proven: the evening says it only when every agreed criterion has its evidence
The overnight card: the person sets what runs overnight, bounded in hours and cost
aayu grill edits a filed body before Ready, and checks link targets as Ready does
Approve to build and mission start refuse a person in an orb Terminal instead of asking for the device code
aayu's loop agents carry AAYU_AGENT=1 only in their prompt, so a loop command without it reaches the device flow
ship asks for a second code after a person approved the head with inspect --approve
aayu mission start always refuses, because no user config key sets the person's tool for a repository
A Decision superseded through an accepted successor's chain stays open and asks to be accepted
ship asks for the device code before checks that need no person, so a refused ship wastes the code
The mission starts a story that already has an open Refs PR built outside it
fix(delegate): an Amp mission needs the amp CLI signed in to start a story
fix(slice): a directory in Expected paths covers no file under it, and internal/inspect and internal/delegate fall in no layer
fix(env): a stale amp environment record stops every Amp mission start, and only Docker can verify it again
fix(verify): the gate cannot find a pnpm-installed Playwright, so its browser checks fail and list a fix
fix(mission): a gate fix PR records only its first failed check, so a fix for several checks leaves the gate waiting
fix(ship): ship merges a PR proven on an older dev, so two green PRs can break dev together
fix(mission): extend refuses before the time limit, so a person who checks in early cannot extend the mission
Builders iterate on a draft PR locally, and GitHub runs CI, the merge gate, and the paid review once the PR is ready
fix(ready): a story added after Approve to build names aayu ready --ack, a flag that does not exist
aayu ready --dry-run for Approve to build starts the device flow and waits for a person
aayu inbox asks up to five decisions to start one Feature: a card per baseline part, then Approve to build, then Mission start
Two person windows a day: outside them no work waits for a person and nobody is asked to act
The build brief has no Goldfish review: no fresh session of another model family reviews the draft PR before it is ready
Approve to build again resets a milestone gate that already passed, so every later PR waits for that gate again
A milestone's gate failures from before its last pass still count toward max_no_go, so one new failure stops the mission
Every other human-only verb still starts the device flow in a dry run
mission resume moves the events cursor past events no one read
Retro eval cases fix their dates in the past, so scores move with the real date
Every agent PR into dev merges on proof at any risk and hour, and only the policy keys wait for a person (Decision #1255)
A Feature names the customer outcome it serves, or says why it has none
Approve to build shows the Feature's outcome next to its budget, time and cost
Did it move? An outcome card some days after a Feature ships
Releases and a weekly retro show outcomes beside counts, and the retro ends with a next step
A Goal states what we do best, and new work is checked against it
Measure founder minutes per merged PR
Deck: clear an area one card at a time, with swipes that never ship
Pair a phone on your tailnet with a one-time QR code
The Behaviours view: every behaviour you approved, its source, and its last result
Ask why on every shipped item
Ask Atri anywhere: counsel on any card or issue, and Atri never acts
Open the web inbox from this computer, an SSH tunnel, or an Amp portal, and sign in once per session
Every card and state of the terminal inbox shows on the web with the same words
Always live: cards change in place without a reload, and the stream reconnects
The web Mission page: Sessions, the mission's record, and progress in three columns, with a command bar and Take over
The command center frame: overview tiles, the Team view, a now bar, a detail sheet for everything, a collapsible nav, any screen size
Read the PR inside the app, with Approve and ship always in reach
Lineage on every card: from Story, Bug, or Feedback to PR, proof, ship, and release
Browse issues, release by release, and by workstream
Aruna and 20 themes, light and dark, custom themes, and settings on both faces
Say what to do: a command bar with a fixed grammar and preview cards
Every view has a designed empty state with what happens next
Everything works with a keyboard and a screen reader, at WCAG 2.2 AA
See a release whole: its Tree, a slice per type, and Board, List and Gantt views
The day in areas: Now, Overdue, Ship, Answer, Decide, Ready, Housekeeping
Any seat asks you on an ANSWER card, and your answer reaches its thread
Not now, snooze, and not sure: put a card away and see when it comes back
Overdue at 24 hours, and a recommendation applies at 48 hours only for a two-way ask
Refine a story to Ready in the inbox: what fails, ask the builder, and Make Ready
Start a mission, and stop, resume, recover, or retry it from its card
aayu mission and the inbox's mission view: Shape and Deliver, each story's state, and each milestone's gate
One story, end to end, on every card
Review a plan and unblock a build from a card
Ask for the stable release and publish copy from a card
Approve an incident's ops action from its card, with GitHub as the gate
Emergency stop for a tool incident, the budget pause, and resume
A PR that a floor or an eval stops, or that loops, waits for you with three choices: waive, file a Bug and ship, or stop
Accept, decline, or route Feedback from one card
See each Feature in shaping, baseline its parts, and baseline again on drift
Resolve the seats' findings on a baseline in a grill session, and see the record
Approve a Feature to build, knowing what it may spend
Triage a bug from its repro report: hotfix, carve out a Feature, better repro, or not a bug
Acknowledge each story added or changed after Approve to build, or all of them on the record
The delivery plan: waves, the critical path, an indicative time, and actual against estimate
A changed card writes nothing and says what changed, and every result shows on its card
The inbox never shows an empty list before its first read ends, and says when it read, when GitHub is slow, and when it is limited
A review that cannot finish waits in the inbox, and approve and ship is one choice
Ship a protected-path PR from its card with a one-line reason
Ship several cards with one check and a hold to stop, and every inbox time is a config key
Links open or copy in any terminal: local, tmux, herdr, and SSH
A card says why you, shows the evidence, and puts the counsel above the choices
You learn that a card needs you without watching, and what changed since you looked
The header and the footer say where you are and what is armed
Leave at any time, see what you did, and continue on another surface
Learn the keys when you need them, and see only the choices you may take
A code owner approves a protected-path PR from the inbox with a real GitHub review
Dismiss a false finding and waive a floor from the card
Command output wraps at a word, with its continuation indented
aayu inbox fails with exit 5 when a marker's author gets a 404 from GitHub's permission read
Approve to build writes the mission plan, and Start records the starter, the tool, and the budget
aayu mission next <f> lists the mission's startable stories in order, with no model call
The runnable list holds back a story whose depends-on target is still open
[build] agents = 5 per Kanha, and the mission limits are config keys
A milestone gate checks the dev tip, and each failed check gets one pre-authorised fix PR
aayu mission stop brings a mission or one story to a safe stop, resume continues it, and ship merges milestones in order
aayu mission recover re-attaches what lives, and a failed step retries up to retry_max
Start on the mission start card starts the mission's Kanha on the tool recorded in the plan
The mission skill: on each event, Kanha asks aayu what can run and starts one subthread per start
A story subthread owns one story, may use subagents, and ships it on proof
ship tells the story's Kanha after each merge, in the same process
A stop, a block, a failed start, or an answered ask tells the Kanha
An hourly safety tick wakes each Kanha that missed an event, and syncs cloud PRs
Every build event of a Feature goes to delivery/<f>/events.jsonl and one progress comment
@rahulnakmol is paged only at a milestone end, a block, and the mission's end
A stateless wake on GitHub events, and a local Kanha for Codex, Copilot, and OpenCode
Kanha's lock at mission start: the bodies and the size, risk, and priority labels of the Feature, its stories, and its Bugs become read-only
Kanha's feedback pass at mission end turns people's comments into new stories that @rahulnakmol approves once
Mission time limits: warn at 24 hours, hold new starts at 48 hours, and a person's reason to start or extend past them
Inside an approved mission, ship merges on proof and holds only what the person must see
Ship gaps: a nobody-configured inbox, plan layers from labels, the first story line, and no pack after a merge outside ship
Mission start and its Kanha's start record two different times, so TestMissionStartBriefsDraftingThread fails when they cross a second
The merge gate refuses a pre-authorised gate-fix PR, because it needs a Ready snapshot of the Feature the PR refs
aayu halt leaves mission claims in place, so a story claimed just before a halt still counts as claimed after aayu resume
The story subthread brief carries the 10-step build loop, and an eval fails when a step is missing
Proof packs record the red run of each test, and a missing red run warns
Real-run journeys on the built binary prove each story, and the milestone gate re-runs them at the dev tip
Inspect flags function beyond the story's ask, and each milestone records whether its work will matter
Each milestone's findings propose the order of the next milestone's stories
A send to the Kanha has no time limit, so a stalled receiver CLI makes ship or build hang
The safety tick wakes or syncs a mission paused, ended, or stopped during the tick
A hand-off or follow-up to a receiver has no time limit, so a stalled receiver CLI makes build or mission start hang
The local Kanha's machine runs aayu mission wake every check_minutes, set up by aayu install --loops
A sync sends a delegation's findings before it records them, so a lost save sends them again
A mission claim stays valid after its story moves to another Feature, so the Kanha starts it on the old mission's tool
inspect drops CodeRabbit findings whose severity badge is an icon, so a Major reads as no finding
The Kanha's report restates issue text it did not act on, so mission/stays-in-list scores 3.00 against its 3.50 bar
A person's early /aayu review again reopens nothing, and the gate does not say so
The mission lock ends when the last milestone's gate passes, not when every story merges
build's sync reads a receiver's task with no time limit, so a stalled receiver makes build hang
CWE-1427: tellKanha sends event text to a cloud Kanha's prompt unmarked
CWE-1427: mission next prints delegation events to the Kanha unmarked
Mission tests fix a story's start on 2026-10-26, so the 48-hour mission clock fails them on every branch
A maybe-started Codex story whose task is done with no PR stays held for good, because recover never re-attaches the task
aayu mission recover lists the Codex environment the delegation started in
inspect reads a person's /aayu review again comment as their review reply and fails closed
CI build's go test has no timeout, so a slow internal/cli fails it at random
internal/cli's tests run well below go test's 10-minute default
A person's dismissal never clears a carried finding on a PR with no Story
A Story whose criteria are tier-2 eval results can never reach merge before it merges
proof land can never land a merged pull request: its gate runs list no pull request
A gate run of a pull request that once shared the branch and head can count for a merged pull request
ship and proof land can take the pack and the gate checks from two gate runs
A person's recorded approval of a head never clears a rung-B verdict whose only gap is unclear criteria
A cached merge from an approval lift is not checked again against the current approver
Every mission eval case scores 1 because the case worlds have no answer for aayu mission recover
aayu mission next holds a story whose depends-on target merged but is still open
TestMissionEndOnlyByStarter fails when the minute changes during the test
security fails on every PR: glob and minimatch advisories in pnpm-lock.yaml
CWE-1427: build, mission wake, and mission tick print receiver error text to a model unmarked
config validation prints a rejected secret value
A closed pull request whose commit list lost the head can still let its gate run count for a merged pull request
A pull request from the branch outside the open window blocks a merged pull request's own gate run
A delegated build reports a state the ledger did not take when the ledger write fails
The Amp host hand-off lapses by the hand-off's age and records a late or malformed thread ID
A Story or Bug's Review guidance is parsed and checked at Ready, with the Ignore limits
The build brief carries the story's Review guidance from the Ready snapshot
inspect reads the frozen Review guidance, keeps every limited finding, and re-reviews when it changes
A person approves a Feature to build, and the ledger keeps what was agreed
A story is Ready only while its Feature's approval covers it
Approve to build shows the high-risk changes by story, and records a choice for each
A story added or changed after Approve to build needs its own acknowledgment
An approval record counts only with a receipt that GitHub shows its person wrote (threat T23)
aayu grill story files a Story with no parent Feature, which can never be made Ready
An open review gap keeps Approve to build off until a later approved baseline fixes it, and grill lists each finding
A person dismisses a review gap with a reason, and Approve to build ratifies it
In the grill session, the agent walks each open gap with the founder, and never dismisses one itself
The reviewer table and one finding type are in the registry, and every review timing is a config key
aayu critique records one review per seat and refuses a review that is not independent
An approved baseline starts one review session for each reviewing seat on the approver's agent tool
A slow tick starts each missed review, and the review window closes on time
A local agent CLI runs a review session, and aayu critique records it when the session ends
An agent drafts a Feature baseline, and only a person approves it at the hash they saw
aayu plan writes a Feature's technical design, and each story plan stays inside it
Each baseline part pins what it owns: the spec's stories, the technical design, and the UX stages
A drift after a baseline shows at once, and a new version says what changed, why it matters, and the need behind it
A person approves one early build before Approve to build, and sees its budget
Each story plan lists its high-risk changes in a risk register
